text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — after this morning's docs deploy a few moved pages are 404ing, and one diagram image is returning 403. Noticed while testing the model onboarding flow.
Maria Rodriguez: Ugh, thanks for the catch. Can you paste a concrete URL example?
Alex Chen: Sure — https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/model-onboarding -> 404. Also https://docs.redwood.ai/assets/serving/kv-cache-diagram.png -> 403. Tried in incognito.
Samir Patel: I can repro the image 403. Looks like the CDN origin path changed when the static site build started adding versioned prefixes.
Alex Chen: Ah that explains it. The redirect for the top-level guide was supposed to be added in the docs router config but may have been missed.
Maria Rodriguez: Who owns the guides dir? @Samir or @Alex? We should assign an owner so these don't slip. :eyes:
Samir Patel: I own the "guides" section but didn't get the heads-up that the build would rename the static assets path. I can patch the redirect and fix the cdn origin mapping.
Alex Chen: If you can, that'd be great. Quick suggested nginx rewrite I tested locally:
```
# redirect moved guide path to new trailing-slash variant
rewrite ^/guides/model-onboarding$ /guides/model-onboarding/ permanent;
# allow CDN origin for assets under /assets/serving/
location /assets/serving/ {
  proxy_pass https://docs-origin-internal/serving/;
}
```
Maria Rodriguez: Looks reasonable. FYI we also surfaced a failing test in the docs CI that didn't block the deploy: `docs-static-link-checker` showed 2 broken links but the job was allowed to soft-fail. I filed a quick issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/452
Alex Chen: Thanks — the issue references the exact pages. Can we make the link-checker block on critical status for guides and assets?
Samir Patel: Yes — I'll change the CI config to fail the pipeline on link-checker exit code != 0 for the guides subset. Will open a PR in a bit.
Docs Bot: deploy succeeded at 2026-11-03T09:12:01Z (build 1256) :white_check_mark:
Maria Rodriguez: OK assigning ownership: Samir, can you own the fix and post a short follow-up here when deployed? If you prefer I'll do the rollback instead.
Samir Patel: I'll take it. Plan: 1) nginx redirect + CDN origin mapping PR 2) adjust CI to fail on broken links for guides 3) run `link-checker` job and confirm no false positives. ETA 2 hours.
Alex Chen: Awesome. If you want a quick review ping me on the PR.
Maria Rodriguez: Thanks all. Leaving this thread pinned to docs channel until fixed. :pin:
__meta_note: Generated Slack thread about docs redirects, CDN asset 403, ownership assignment, and CI link-check config. Single-string thread per agents.md rules.
